exposure: severity of histological maternal inflammatory response (chorioamniotic membranes, placenta, umbilical cord)
severity of histological fetal inflammatory response (chorioamniotic membranes, placenta, umbilical cord)
cohort: The study included 138 patients with preterm delivery between 22 and 33 weeks, delivered between January 2007 and May 2017.
finding: The severity of histological maternal and fetal inflammatory responses correlated with the prevalence of clinical chorioamnionitis and positive maternal clinical signs in preterm deliveries.
birth_weight: Measured as an outcome, but no specific inclusion range was mentioned.
